title: Built a custom backend API for my trading engine to get data from (I dont use AI for trades, at all.  I have a local AI Model inside my trading engine)
author: DarkandBoring
selftext:
I do not use AI for every decision, (meaning claude or openai)  Instead I have a small local AI model inside my engine for decision making based on a lot of rules, and a lot of data. Past data, Present data, and it uses my back end with over 300 API Endpoints for data based on deciison making.  I plugged it in and instantly it started taking trades it was never taking before.

  
It also has a post/get method as it starts on a hitlist (From trading engine) it posts the open positions and reads the tape via websocket, from websocket to websocket.  I literally solved the execution problem x3..  Since I started doing this the trading engine KNOWS what the bid/ask is immediately upon the plan for entry.   It has improved execution by about 47%  Now my momentum strategies are able to actually do what they are supposed to do..

I have many stats/logs/trades   I have been testing/using the engine for over 4 months now on a large scale 3 computers daily.   With low risk and about 2000$ per account it will on the average make around 2-400$ daily.  A+ setups level 10 Only... If i relax the regulations and go after 6-8 Setups as it rates and scores each potential trade before it takes it also.  but... more risk more reward, more risk also incurs more losses.  on average I have about 5-6 strategies with a 55%+ WinRate.  (My strategies are solely based on Winrate alone. Im thinking longevity)

If anyone needs any help or wants to speak feel free.
